# Planly

All-in-one social media management tool for scheduling and managing content across multiple platforms

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/planly/.

## Actions

- **Complete AI Prompt**: Complete a text prompt using AI.
- **Create Team**: Create a new team in Planly.
- **Edit Team**: Edit team details such as name in Planly.
- **Get Team** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific team including permissions, limits, and integrations.
- **List Channels** (read-only): List all social media channels connected to a team.
- **List media files** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of media files in a team.
- **List Schedule Groups** (read-only): Retrieve a list of schedule groups for a team with comprehensive filtering and pagination.
- **List Schedules** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of schedules in a specified team.
- **List Teams** (read-only): Retrieve all teams that the authenticated user belongs to.
- **Start Media Upload**: Start the upload process for a media file.
- **Delete Media**: Delete one or more media files by their IDs.
- **Delete Team**: Delete a team by its ID.
- **Get AI Credits** (read-only): Retrieve available AI credits left in a team.
- **Import Media From URL**: Import media from a URL to your team.
- **List Team Users** (read-only): List all users that belong to a specific team.
